title: ServiceNow says attackers exploited a flaw, patched on June 5, that let unauthenticated users query data from customer instances, but gives few other details (Lawrence Abrams/BleepingComputer)
summary: Lawrence Abrams / BleepingComputer: ServiceNow says attackers exploited a flaw, patched on June 5, that let unauthenticated users query data from customer instances, but gives few other details — ServiceNow is warning about a security incident after attackers exploited an unauthenticated access flaw through a vulnerable API endpoint …
